perm_feature.label: Edit your own profile
perm_feature.description: Change your own display name and username. Your email address cannot be changed here.

perm_feature.label: Add two-step verification
perm_feature.description: Enrol a second factor on your own account.

perm_feature.label: Remove two-step verification
perm_feature.description: Take a second factor off your own account.

perm_feature.label: Manage billing
perm_feature.description: Start, change or end an organization or workspace subscription.

perm_feature.label: Look somebody up to invite them
perm_feature.description: Find a person by their exact email address. No prefix or partial search.

perm_feature.label: Invite to a conversation
perm_feature.description: Add somebody to a conversation you are in.

perm_feature.label: Administer any conversation
perm_feature.description: Rename any group, add and remove its people, and decide who runs it — without being in it. Does not grant reading any message.

perm_feature.label: Moderate a conversation
perm_feature.description: Delete somebody else's message in a conversation you are in.

perm_feature.label: Use chat
perm_feature.description: See conversations and read messages in them.

perm_feature.label: Remove a participant
perm_feature.description: Remove somebody else from a conversation you are in. The creator cannot be removed.

perm_feature.label: Send messages
perm_feature.description: Post into a conversation you are in.

perm_feature.label: Start a conversation
perm_feature.description: Open a direct chat or create a group. Subject to the group-chat cap.

perm_feature.label: Manage defaults
perm_feature.description: Change them. Whoever holds this decides what role every new account and every organization’s founder is granted from then on, without the no-escalation check that guards granting a role by hand.

perm_feature.label: Read defaults
perm_feature.description: See what every new account, organization and workspace is created with.

perm_feature.label: Create features
perm_feature.description: Define one new feature by hand.

perm_feature.label: Retire features
perm_feature.description: Remove a feature from the registry. Deprecates rather than deletes, so grants stay readable.

perm_feature.label: Import features
perm_feature.description: Define many features at once from a spreadsheet.

perm_feature.label: View the feature registry
perm_feature.description: See every right a role can grant, and where each one is enforced.

perm_feature.label: Update features
perm_feature.description: Change an existing feature's definition, for everyone already holding it.

perm_feature.label: Assign member roles
perm_feature.description: Grant or revoke an organization-level role on a member.

perm_feature.label: Invite members
perm_feature.description: Invite an address to join, add somebody who already has an account, and withdraw an invitation.

perm_feature.label: Manage members
perm_feature.description: Invite, remove and re-role people in the organization.

perm_feature.label: Read members
perm_feature.description: See who is in the organization, and who has been invited.

perm_feature.label: Remove members
perm_feature.description: Remove somebody from the organization. Their roles and workspace memberships go with them.

perm_feature.label: Recall notifications
perm_feature.description: Take back a send from every inbox it reached — including notifications the system sent.

perm_feature.label: Receive notifications
perm_feature.description: See your own notifications, mark them read or unread, archive them, and receive them live.

perm_feature.label: Send notifications
perm_feature.description: Send a notification to chosen people as the platform, and see what you have sent.

perm_feature.label: Rename this organization
perm_feature.description: Change this organization’s name, or the key that names it in a URL.

perm_feature.label: Open this organization
perm_feature.description: See this organization’s overview, its people and its workspaces.

perm_feature.label: Rename organizations
perm_feature.description: Change an organization’s name or key.

perm_feature.label: Read organizations
perm_feature.description: See the organizations on the platform, and one organization’s members and workspaces.

perm_feature.label: Update this organization
perm_feature.description: Change this organization’s name, its key, or its description.

perm_feature.label: Archive plans
perm_feature.description: Retire a plan so nothing new can subscribe to it, and bring one back. Plans are never deleted.

perm_feature.label: Create plans
perm_feature.description: Define a new plan and choose what it entitles.

perm_feature.label: Read plans
perm_feature.description: See the plans that exist and what each one entitles.

perm_feature.label: Update plans
perm_feature.description: Change what an existing plan entitles, under everyone already subscribed to it.

perm_feature.label: Support access
perm_feature.description: Enter any organization to help its users.

perm_feature.label: Assign windows
perm_feature.description: Assign a window to a member, including yourself, move someone to another window, or free a window.

perm_feature.label: Manage windows and lines
perm_feature.description: Create, rename and archive windows and lines, set a line's next number, and clear a staff nickname.

perm_feature.label: See the queue
perm_feature.description: Open the queue console and watch every window live.

perm_feature.label: Serve at a window
perm_feature.description: Call, recall and complete numbers at the window you are assigned, while queuing is running.

perm_feature.label: Start queuing
perm_feature.description: Start a queuing session, which generates the code that admits public displays, and choose whether displays show staff nicknames.

perm_feature.label: Stop queuing
perm_feature.description: Stop the queuing session. Every public display goes dark; window assignments are kept.

perm_feature.label: Create roles
perm_feature.description: Define a new role and choose what it grants.

perm_feature.label: Disable roles
perm_feature.description: Turn a role off so it grants nothing, and turn it back on. Roles are never deleted.

perm_feature.label: Grant app-level roles
perm_feature.description: Give a person an app-level role, or change the one they hold. Refuses any role carrying more than the granter holds.

perm_feature.label: Manage app-level roles
perm_feature.description: Write roles that apply across every organization. Required alongside create, update or delete.

perm_feature.label: Read roles
perm_feature.description: See the roles that exist and what each one grants.

perm_feature.label: Update roles
perm_feature.description: Change what an existing role grants, including cloning another role into it.

perm_feature.label: Read subscriptions
perm_feature.description: See which plan an organization is on, its status and when it renews.

perm_feature.label: Create users
perm_feature.description: Create an account directly, without an invitation.

perm_feature.label: Delete users
perm_feature.description: Remove an account permanently. Suspension is the reversible alternative and is usually the right one.

perm_feature.label: Disable users
perm_feature.description: Suspend an account so it cannot sign in, and lift the suspension again. Accounts are never deleted.

perm_feature.label: Reset a user's password
perm_feature.description: Send a password reset to another account's address. Never sets a password directly.

perm_feature.label: Edit a user's profile
perm_feature.description: Change another person's display name or username. Their email address cannot be changed.

perm_feature.label: Read users
perm_feature.description: List, search and open any account on the platform, and see where one is signed in.

perm_feature.label: Read a user's sessions
perm_feature.description: See where an account is signed in: device, address and last use.

perm_feature.label: End a user's sessions
perm_feature.description: Sign an account out of every device it is signed in on.

perm_feature.label: Suspend users
perm_feature.description: Suspend an account so it cannot sign in, and lift a suspension again.

perm_feature.label: Remove a user's two-step verification
perm_feature.description: Take a second factor off another person's account, for somebody locked out of their own.

perm_feature.label: Update users
perm_feature.description: Change an account's name and username, send it a password reset, end its sessions, or remove its second factor.

perm_feature.label: Assign workspace roles
perm_feature.description: Grant or revoke a workspace-level role here.

perm_feature.label: Add workspace members
perm_feature.description: Give somebody already in the organization access to this workspace.

perm_feature.label: Remove workspace members
perm_feature.description: Remove somebody from this workspace. They stay in the organization.

perm_feature.label: Open a workspace
perm_feature.description: Open a workspace you are a member of, and see who else is in it.

perm_feature.label: Access all workspaces
perm_feature.description: See every workspace in the organization without being added to it.

perm_feature.label: Archive workspaces
perm_feature.description: Archive a workspace. It stops resolving and nobody can act inside it. There is no delete.

perm_feature.label: Create workspaces
perm_feature.description: Create a workspace. Bounded by the plan’s workspace cap.

perm_feature.label: Manage workspaces
perm_feature.description: Create, rename and archive workspaces.

perm_feature.label: Read workspaces
perm_feature.description: See the organization’s workspaces, live and archived.

perm_feature.label: Share workspaces
perm_feature.description: Give another member access to a workspace.

perm_feature.label: Update workspaces
perm_feature.description: Rename a workspace, or change its key or description.
